hypothesis: The pinned public trigger-stage package (RAdam/cosine, residual train BN, forward-clamped latent) may behave differently from the completed literal projected-SGD/eval implementation under exactly the same saved teacher and augmented input sequence. This tests a declared package correction, not a unique causal factor or a guaranteed performance fix.
new_observable: A new public-AST trigger trajectory on the exact old200 input batches, all RAdam/BN/latent histories, first/last independent CPU gradients, and frozen-original-teacher zero/old/new-delta counts and CE on the same final200 inputs.
comparison: Reuse the completed SGD manifest and delta as stored comparator; do not retrain the old teacher/SGD/SSS/FU/evaluation. CPU2/FP32/MKLDNN is the same as the completed CPU trigger; optimizer/scheduler/BN/projection are jointly changed. Individual causal effects are not isolated.
launch_mode: SSH Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden direct Python controller; no task recreation, no autorestart

constants.model_mode: train, all parameters requires_grad False; BN buffers evolve in private copy
constants.latent_projection: none; public limit_noise clamp only in forward/final
constants.source_zero_gradient_break: original ave_grad==0 at epoch end, no performance early stop

author_source.ports: three .cuda() calls to .cpu(); RAdam constructor to audited subclass using super.step unchanged; missing apply_noise_patch explicitly recovered as add; saved-input loader and progress wrappers only

stopping_rule: Run one candidate to the fixed public100-epoch maximum or its original exact-zero-gradient break; preserve any source/hash/input-ID/finite/storage/RNG/runtime/numeric failure and stop with no automatic retry. No seed/lr/epoch/epsilon/data/budget tuning. Independent gradients atol2e-5/rtol.001 and logits1e-6/1e-5 unchanged. Stop after audit/endpoint whether favorable or not; SSS/FU/victim-ASR require a separate explicit source/profile binding before execution.
large_benign_scope: This is attack-implementation conformance, not detection. A benign teacher can show the same response. D08 attack.75848 between benign.75525/.76188 and D15 attack7/benign8 remain unresolved; unknown trigger families are unvalidated. No change-magnitude detector proposed.
privacy: All new tensors/RNG/BN/IDs/raw inputs/logits remain private on DISLAB. No bulk local packet is required for computation.
